links.outcome: Biomedical QA accuracy and judged evidence grounding of retrieval-grounded answers with citations
links.effect: 78.32% accuracy on PubMedQA with GPT-4o, slightly above human experts; consistent gains on MMLU Clinical Knowledge; LLM judges preferred responses for evidence grounding.
links.quote: PubMed Reasoner with a GPT-4o backbone achieves 78.32% accuracy on PubMedQA, slightly surpassing human experts, and showing consistent gains on MMLU Clinical Knowledge.

unlisted_practices: Self-critic MeSH query refinement based on partial metadata retrieval before full retrieval
Batch-wise reflective retrieval that stops once sufficient evidence is gathered

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel multi-stage RAG/agent system (PubMed Reasoner) on biomedical question answering benchmarks (PubMedQA, MMLU Clinical Knowledge). As a new agent architecture/system benchmark rather than an evaluation of an organizational deployment guardrail, tests_practice is false.
